name: Juan Zhang
title: Frontend Developer
aboutMe: 5 years of frontend development experience, proficient in Vue2 and React, with a strong focus on data visualization and enterprise back-office systems. Worked on large-scale projects for banking and government sectors, solving challenges in performance optimization, component encapsulation, and map interactions. Self‑motivated, reliable, and detail‑oriented, continuously learning new technologies. Currently based in Chengdu, seeking frontend development roles.

projects.name: Data Security Integrated Management System (PC)
projects.description: An internal back‑office management system for a major financial institution, covering user management, workflow approval, ledger management, risk monitoring dashboard, annual task management, training courses, and a mobile mini‑program.
bullets: Implemented full‑featured pages for both PC and mobile, including form caching, file preview/download, and infinite scrolling lists.
Developed data visualization dashboards (pie charts, bar charts, etc.) with customized pagination for chart legends.
Optimized download experience, resolved request race conditions, and fixed drag‑and‑drop compatibility issues in table components.

projects.name: Department Solution Portal
projects.description: A solution showcase portal built for the business department, targeting frontline employees. Includes carousel, trending topics, panorama, course display, customer cases, expert introductions, lab environment, and integrated sales charts.
bullets: Independently designed page layouts and implemented UI components.
Used ECharts to visualize project sales trends and visitor statistics.
Optimized initial page load performance by consolidating API requests.

projects.name: Smart City Command Dashboard (7K Resolution)

bullets: Implemented map interactions (camera marker popups, patrol route drawing).
Developed 9 ECharts chart modules (bar, line, donut) with custom tooltips.
Built a custom word‑cloud component to display real‑time trending keywords.
Pushed live alert lists via WebSocket with auto‑scrolling updates.

projects.name: Traffic Command Dashboard (1080P)
projects.description: A traffic monitoring dashboard for a district government, showing police deployment, real‑time alerts, and device status.
bullets: Developed the full‑screen interface and integrated data APIs based on design mockups.
Integrated weather data (OpenWeatherMap with Gaode API fallback).
Customized ECharts map styling to display police force data on hover.
Built a curved carousel component for multi‑metric cards.
Kept data up‑to‑date via polling intervals.
Resolved iframe embedding issues using Nginx and implemented responsive layout.
